landing.specimenLabel: A portfolio built by LivePortfolio, with invented content
landing.specimenNote: Same words, three looks. This is a sample, not a real person.
landing.specimenHeadline: I build payment systems that stay up, and I can show you the numbers.
landing.specimenAbout: Five years building payment and ledger systems in Go and Postgres, most of it at a Lagos fintech serving two million customers.
landing.specimenOutcome1: Nightly reconciliation went from 3 hours to 9 minutes, with zero manual fixes in 6 months.
landing.specimenOutcome2: p95 latency down 40% during traffic spikes; no checkout incidents since launch.
landing.specimenOutcome3: Cut data entry from 40 hours a week to 6.
landing.speakable: LivePortfolio helps professionals turn their work into opportunities.
landing.heroBody: Upload your CV or tell us your story. We write it up as a finished portfolio at your own address, and you choose how it looks. Free to build and preview.
landing.heroAudience: For developers, designers, data scientists, clinicians, graduates and freelancers, anywhere in the world.
landing.ctaNote: Free to build and preview. No credit card required. Publish only when you're ready.
landing.specimenProblem1: The old ledger could not reconcile card and bank transfers without a nightly manual step.
landing.specimenProblem2: Twelve services each rolled their own limits, and one bad client could take down checkout.
landing.specimenProblem3: Supplier invoices were keyed in by hand.
landing.specimenSolution1: Moved to an append-only double-entry ledger with idempotent writes.
landing.specimenSolution2: A shared token-bucket limiter with per-tenant budgets.
landing.specimenSolution3: A parser that reads PDFs and posts matched lines to the ledger.
landing.specimenCaption: The top of a sample portfolio
landing.looksLede: Pick the look that suits your work. You can switch at any time, and your text never changes.
